Definition: from the base of G4517; strength; Roma, the capital of Italy:--Rome.
BiblicalUsage: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints, Paul wrote his great letter, and when he came to Rome he was delivered to the captain of the guard and suffered to dwell by himself. There Onesiphorus sought him out very diligently and found him.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that Rome is where the gospel proved it could live in the heart of the empire, and the church there was beloved before Paul ever saw it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
